name: identity_part_promote_to_brand
title: Save identity object variant to Brand Studio
description: App-only explicit promotion for an already-inserted opener/outro object. Reads the addressed Program occurrence, promotes its preset params and gain to the project Brand Studio default opener/outro slot or to that role's alternates through the same identity_apply_to_project path, writes a promotion receipt, and affects future reels only. It does not mutate this or any other composition, and it never changes the pack enabled state.

episode_id.description: Composition/episode public ID containing the identity object.

project_id.description: Optional project public ID; must match the episode project when supplied.

identity_layer_instance_key.description: Stable identity layer instance key stamped on the segment.

role.description: Allowed only when exactly one matching identity object exists.

promote_as.description: Where to save the object variant. Defaults to default; alternate adds it to the role's bounded alternates list.

prewarm.description: Whether to enqueue opener/outro source-backed prewarm. Defaults true.
